propositions: Link-sync unit tests exercise the relation vocabulary with only a single representative (blocks) rather than the full set, leaving unmapped relations (duplicates, supersedes, discovered_from) and direction-swap cases (depends_on outbound) untested.

The outbound _diff_links emission test must be parametrized over all six relations, asserting the correct (jira_type, swap) tuple for mapped relations and an empty mutation list for unmapped relations.

A REMOVE mutation test case must cover the untested branch where a Jira issue carries an outward Blocks link and the local depends_on dependency was removed, verifying the emitted mutation is {action: remove, relation: depends_on}.
Test assertions must verify per-relation orientation (e.g., swap=True for depends_on) rather than mere presence, so that a reversion of the c8ed swap fix would cause test failures.
